lesson.title: Find the relevant product legislation
lesson.summary: Find the exact listed product instrument and avoid applying all obligations from classification alone.

prerequisites.reason: Tracing the product legislation requires navigating an annex locator.

blocks: An **Annex I lookup** identifies the exact Union product instrument. The list includes toys, lifts, radio and pressure equipment, protective equipment, medical devices and other specified sectors.
Northbridge records the instrument, product scope and intended function. A product being generally regulated is not enough: the relevant legislation must be listed and actually cover this product.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex I Sections A and B; Article 2(2), 2(13); Article 6(1)

blocks: Read the current section and point, not an old diagram. In our July 2026 baseline, Section A point 1 is deleted and the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 appears in Section B point 21.
This is a concrete reason to retain the source version. Do not continue citing the deleted machinery entry as operative. The sector legislation's own application and transition rules remain relevant.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex I Sections A and B; Article 2(2), 2(13); Article 6(1)

blocks: **Sector scope limits** concern which AI Act provisions apply after classification. Under Article 2(2), high-risk Article 6(1) systems related to Section B products have specified limited AI Act application, with conditions for certain innovation provisions.

A Section B classification does not automatically import every Chapter III duty. The wording lists Article 6(1), Article 60a and Articles 102–112; Articles 57–59 have an integration condition. Look up the actual list.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex I Sections A and B; Article 2(2), 2(13); Article 6(1)

blocks: Article 2(13) permits specified limitations for equivalent-or-higher protection under Section A legislation without reducing overall protection, with delegated specification. It is a conditional mechanism, not a vendor-created exemption.

Northbridge's record links product scope, list entry, assessment route and obligation-scope questions. If the sector classification is unresolved, state the missing evidence instead of declaring an assumed product class.
